relay/get-userinfo: Bun before 1.4.3 drops the credentials of a user:pass@ URL; Rust (like 1.4.3 and later) sends them as Basic authorization
relay/get-userinfo-percent: same: Bun before 1.4.3 drops percent-encoded credentials
relay/get-userinfo-only-name: Bun before 1.4.3 resolves 'user@host' as a host name and answers 502; Rust (like 1.4.3 and later) connects and sends 'Basic user:'
relay/head: Bun before 1.4.3 answers a HEAD chunked, with no content-length; Rust (like 1.4.3 and later) keeps the upstream's content-length
relay/connection-refused: Bun before 1.4.3 words a refused connect without the ECONNREFUSED prefix; Rust (like 1.4.3 and later) has it
